technical.summary: Short-term momentum signals (RSI, Stoch, EMA 9/21 cross) show bullish setup, but lack ADX confirmation, MACD support, and long-term trend alignment; suitable for tactical swing only with tight risk management.

fundamental.summary: WHR shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk with 56 days to next report.

sentiment.summary: No congressional signal; market in fear (40 VIX equivalent) with bearish sentiment (42%) presents potential contrarian opportunity, but lack of recent news data and stale congressional trades (296+ days old) limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (315.2) indicates extreme market stress, and Consumer Discretionary sector faces demand destruction in risk-off environment; earnings in 56 days adds event risk but secondary to acute macro deterioration.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term momentum crossovers (EMA 9/21 golden cross, Stoch bullish cross, StochRSI up) with price near support (130.77) offer tactical swing entry in fear-zone contrarian setup.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is severely deteriorated (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels, recession signals), fundamentals are absent (no insider/institutional conviction, high earnings risk in 56 days), and technical setup lacks ADX confirmation, MACD support, and long-term trend alignment—momentum alone insufficient against systemic headwinds.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term momentum crossovers (EMA 9/21 golden cross, Stoch bullish) present tactical setup at support, but macro deterioration (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, recession signals) and absent fundamental conviction make risk/reward unfavourable for swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: Macro environment in acute distress (VIX 315.2, inverted yield curve) creates systemic headwind that overwhelms short-term technical momentum; Consumer Discretionary demand destruction likely in risk-off regime.
